statement: CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE workspace.mlpaba35f2a.scored50223c USING DELTA AS SELECT r.request_id, r.account_id, ROUND(SQRT(POWER(r.request_lat - p.home_lat, 2) + POWER(r.request_lon - p.home_lon, 2)), 6) AS distance_deg, ROUND(p.base_score - 0.1 * ROUND(SQRT(POWER(r.request_lat - p.home_lat, 2) + POWER(r.request_lon - p.home_lon, 2)), 6), 6) AS score FROM (SELECT request_id, account_id, CAST(request_lat AS DOUBLE) AS request_lat, CAST(request_lon AS DOUBLE) AS request_lon FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpaba35f2a/data_upload/requests.csv', format => 'csv', header => true)) r JOIN (SELECT account_id, CAST(home_lat AS DOUBLE) AS home_lat, CAST(home_lon AS DOUBLE) AS home_lon, CAST(base_score AS DOUBLE) AS base_score FROM read_files('/Volumes/workspace/mlpaba35f2a/data_upload/profiles.csv', format => 'csv', header => true)) p ON r.account_id = p.account_id
